verdict.rationale: The firm's own materials cover the 'Canadian or other interim options' part of the story: it practices in both Canada and the U.S., describes Canadian Start-Up Visa work-permit extensions, and documents the J-1 university-incubator route for running a start-up with legal U.S. status. None of this is framed as a fallback, and the other two elements are absent. Missing for 10: guidance on running the company remotely while waiting, any coverage of what happens after a denial (appeals, refiling, alternatives), and an explicit honest discussion of fallbacks rather than general service listings.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's materials honestly cover the fallbacks — running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other interim options, and what happens after a denial
